rule: Each world step: pick the day part from the clock, read the subtile encounter frequency (from config), shift it by one fifteenth on easy or hard, then roll 0 to 100; no encounter at or above the frequency. An encounter is spotted by a separate roll on outdoorsman (plus 20 with a motion scanner, capped at 95, plus a tile modifier). Spotted: award 100 minus the spotting value in XP and offer a yes or no to engage (no hides the icon). Unspotted: the encounter starts with no prompt. In a vehicle, the frequency is first reduced by a day-part modifier. Level-up: XP thresholds from a table function, a pending level-up state, a sound, and endurance-based hit points.
keep: Two-roll structure: chance per step, then a separate spotting roll

look_test: Phone 375 wide: a 30-step world-map strip with a moving dot; a blinking icon on rolled steps; a yes or no prompt only on spotted steps. Run one day pass and one night pass with higher frequency. Dom walks, then judges: does the prompt read as a choice, is the blink visible at a glance, does an unspotted ambush feel fair.
